name: venue-card
title: Venue card
description: A local business in a directory: photo, name, category, rating, price level, distance and an open-now status in words, with a save button.
docs: name is the one link of the card (href, with onOpen for a client-side router). image is an address or { src, alt }; without one a quiet tile says 'No photo yet', and a photo that does not load gets the same tile saying 'Photo unavailable'. category, priceLevel and distance sit on one line: priceLevel is 1 to 4, drawn as priceSymbol repeated with the unspent symbols faint and said to screen readers as Inexpensive, Moderate, Expensive or Very expensive, and distance is a number of metres (written '450 m', '1.2 km', or with units='imperial' '0.3 mi' and '350 ft') or your own words. rating and ratingCount draw the stars to the exact average and read as a sentence. openNow says whether the venue is open, as a word with a glyph: a filled dot and 'Open until 22:00', a hollow one and 'Closed, opens at 09:30'. You work it out from the venue's own clock; the card only says it. closesAt and opensAt are a wall-clock string ('22:00', written as it says in the locale) or a moment written in timeZone. tags show the first three as chips and count the rest. saved, defaultSaved and onSave make a heart toggle with aria-pressed, named 'Save Café Halcyon', above the card's link. labels carries every word.
